summary.headline: Virgo and Libra in Astrology
summary.text: Astrological descriptions of Virgo and Libra, covering their planetary houses, gender, elemental and seasonal qualities, bodily rulerships, character traits of those born under them, decans, weather, and countries subject to each sign. Virgo rules the belly and internal parts; Libra governs measures, weights, wine, oil, perfumery, and abundance.
